cases.failure_class: Build uploader/supply-chain compromise crossing into CI credentials
cases.review_question: Do workflows fetch executable dependencies or uploaders without provenance validation, and what credentials would those jobs receive?

cases.failure_class: Untrusted pull-request content executed in privileged workflows
cases.review_question: Can external PR-controlled data reach privileged execution, workflows, cache, artifacts, or shell commands?

cases.failure_class: Compromised session access and overly broad downstream credentials
cases.review_question: Are credentials scoped, rotated, isolated from model inputs, and prevented from reaching untrusted logs or tools?
